overview_description.description:
Coris is a modern risk infrastructure for vertical Software-a-as-Service companies and payment processors. Coris provides relevant alternative data about merchants for efficient and automated underwriting, as well as early warning signals before a merchant goes out of business. With native integration to Stripe Connect, Coris also provides a comprehensive Merchant Risk platform for risk teams to underwrite and manage risk of SMBs.

Coris is headquartered in Palo Alto, California and is backed by Y Combinator plus a slew of prominent investors.
